cause_claim: The proposed change adds rule-0291 with 2 explicit fields (f02, f21) for template T7 which requires field_count=21. However, the rule detail specifies "all other fields wildcard", meaning unlisted fields are implicitly handled. Experiments show: baseline had 3 rules checked/0 rejected, candidate had 4 rules checked/0 rejected (rule-0291 included). Content-interpreter processed 50 events with 4 rules, exit_code=0, 0 matches. All contracts pass: ic-0023 (instance_of, matches_on=f02,f21), ic-0024 (field_count=21 from template-registry), ic-0025 (field_count=21 check by rule-validator), ic-0026 (inputs_supplied=21 for interpreter). The "wildcard" language in the rule allows remaining fields to be implicit.
